notes.title: A free web version is available.
notes.notes:
You can now play this game for free on Itchio:
[url=https://sylvie.itch.io/you-are-such-a-soft-and-round-kitten]https://sylvie.itch.io/you-are-such-a-soft-and-round-kitten[/url]
Or on my website:
[url=http://love-game.net/10mgPresentsYouAreSuchASoftAndRoundKittenBySylvie/]http://love-game.net/10mgPresentsYouAreSuchASoftAndRoundKittenBySylvie/[/url]

There are no significant differences between the downloadable version and the web version. The reason the downloadable version is not free is because:

[b]1.[/b] To make a Steam game free, I have to manually contact Steam Support and ask them to make it free.
[b]2.[/b] The game is part of the 10mg Bundle and I don't know how making it free would affect the bundle.

I do not recommend purchasing the downloadable version unless you want to support me by giving me money, or if you really want this game to appear in your Steam library.

notes.title: Indie collective 10mg announce their first dose of bite-sized games
notes.notes:
Aching fingers? Throbbing headache? Feeling burnt out on massive videogames? I’m no doctor, but it sounds like you need a prescription for some cheap indie darlings. That’s the idea behind Ten Minute Games (or 10mg), at least, with the indie collective today announcing plans to dish out their first bundle of tiny, experimental games later this month.

I’d phone a doctor if that headache keeps up, though. Might be serious.
